risks.message: The member-app directory is untracked in the parent landing-page repository, so this snapshot has no member-app commit provenance.
src/App.jsx is a 4,399-line application controller containing authentication, continuation, payment gating and most member screens.
The Lambda uses manual path and method dispatch; generic route regexes missed every API route until manual verification.
Build and CloudFormation preparation exist, but no deployment or CI command is declared in member-app/package.json.
contract.json lists fewer work-rights and sponsorship values than server/service.mjs accepts; the contract needs reconciliation.
Production health for Stripe, OpenAI, Freehire, Cognito, S3, DynamoDB and SSM depends on deployed configuration and was not tested by this static documentation run.
The source-level external-AI ceiling is US$5 per Sydney day, while the effective daily approval is runtime state in DynamoDB.
